rule: No card, no credits, no paid API. If a job cannot be done free, it waits or ships at the free ceiling — it never gets billed.

providers.name: Google Colab (free)
providers.quota: dynamic — no published number, sessions can end when demand spikes

providers.name: Kaggle Notebooks
providers.gpu: 2x Tesla T4 (16 GB each, not pooled) or 1x P100 16 GB
providers.quota: ~30 GPU hours per week, hard counter shown in account, resets weekly
not_fits: Ovi / Kandinsky (needs 24 GB on ONE card)
anything that needs a persistent server
providers.role: weekly workhorse when Colab quota dies

providers.name: Lightning AI Studio (free plan)
providers.gpu: T4 / L4 share of 15 monthly credits
providers.quota: 15 credits per month (≈ dozens of T4 hours; Studio restarts every 4 h)
not_fits: Ovi (24 GB needs L40S credits — too few free hours)
providers.role: backup when both Colab and Kaggle are exhausted

providers.name: Your own machine (CPU only)
providers.role: always-available final mile: audio mix, upscale (lanczos), verify, assemble

providers.name: Hugging Face ZeroGPU (free)
providers.quota: 5 minutes of GPU per day on a free account
fits: a single short hero shot if a Space exposes the model
not_fits: own-model deploys (PRO needed to create Spaces)

excluded_on_purpose.why: payment method must be on file — violates zero-spend
asks for billing after the free taste

weekly_budget_plan.colab_free: 3-4 sessions x 1.5 h = draft clips + upscale + audio
weekly_budget_plan.kaggle: 6-8 h of the 30 h quota = the reliable batch (one full reel per 2 h)
weekly_budget_plan.lightning: keep untouched as the emergency reserve
weekly_budget_plan.local_cpu: voice, mix, verify, assemble — never burns GPU

ceiling.stretch: 720p native from Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B fp8+offload on a Kaggle T4 (very slow)
not_possible_free: 1080p+ native diffusion on a 16 GB card
